requirements.text: Proposals invited from NICSI empanelled agencies for Web Portal / Website Development
Bidder must be a firm/company/proprietorship registered under Indian Companies Act 1956 or Partnership Act 1932 with GST registration and valid PAN/TAN
Bidder must have a registered office or branch office in New Delhi
At least 05 years of experience in web designing, building and maintenance (03 years for MSMEs/Startups/SHGs)
Average turnover more than Rs.50,00,000 over five years among FYs 2018-19 to 2023-24
Positive net worth for any of 5 years among FYs 2018-19 to 2023-24
Undertaking that the agency has not been blacklisted by any government body and no litigation with any government department on IT services
Completed at least 5 orders for website development during 2018-2023 each not less than Rs. 5,00,000, with not less than 10 employees on payroll
Agency should hold a valid CMMI Level 5 certificate issued by CMMI Institute
Bid security (Earnest Money Deposit) of Rs 2,10,000
Sub-contracting, subletting, Joint Venture or Consortium bids not permitted
Website availability mandated at 99.99% uptime with 24X7X365 monitoring
Web Portal fully compliant with GIGW, WCAG 2.0 and other GOI guidelines
Comprehensive Security Audit by a CERT-In empanelled agency before going live
Portal hosted in a Data Centre located in India by a MeitY empanelled CSP
Total Project time shall be 120 Business days; execution to begin within 15 days of approval
Performance Security of about 5% of the contract value
Penalty for delay of 0.5% of contract value per week, subject to maximum of 5% of Total Contract Value
